name: The Ordinary Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% in Vitamin F, Hydrating Vitamin C Oil for Even Skin Tone
description: Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% in Vitamin F is a lightweight oil that helps reduce signs of aging by brightening and balancing uneven skin tone. Unlike direct forms of vitamin C, this hydrating formulation contains an oil-soluble vitamin C derivative that converts into vitamin C once applied. Plus, it has vitamin F to help support your skin’s natural hydration barrier.
